jobs.title: Manager, Business Management - Product Owner, Strategic Finance & Transformation
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   97593

NextEra Energy Resources is one of America’s largest wholesale electricity generators, harnessing diverse energy sources to power progress. We deliver tailored energy solutions that fuel economic growth, strengthen communities, and help customers achieve their energy goals. Ready to make a lasting impact? Take the next step in your career with us!

Position Specific Description

NextEra is seeking a hands-on product leader to join the Transformation Office within the Business Management organization. Business Management owns the P&L for one of the largest renewable asset portfolios in the world and is responsible for ensuring these assets meet their financial commitments through:

•  Acting as the CEO of the assets

•  Maximizing revenue and optimizing operational performance

•  Driving optimal commercial and regulatory outcomes

The Transformation Office is building a portfolio of decision-support products - optimization engines, scenario and lifecycle financial models, and the reporting and governance layer around them - that change how multi-billion-dollar operating and capital decisions are made across the fleet. The strategy and the analytical thinking are in place. What we need now is someone who can land them.

In this role you will be the product owner and delivery spine for that portfolio. You will sit between the business - Business Management, Power Generation (PGD), Operations and Finance - and the technical teams that build, including internal data science and engineering groups and external analytics and consulting partners. You will turn business intent into precise, testable requirements; drive the build through to production; and own the harder half of the job: adoption. Success in this role is not a model that works. Success is a planner, a business manager or an operating committee changing what they actually do because of it.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely bilingual. You will need to be credible enough with data scientists to challenge an objective function, a data assumption or a validation approach, and credible enough with operators and executives to explain in plain business language why the answer is right and what it is worth. You will also be the person who keeps the program honest: clear owners, dates, decisions, dependencies and risks, communicated on a reliable cadence, with early and specific escalation when something starts to drift.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy in an environment with real ambiguity. You are expected to own the decision framing for your products - not simply take dictation - and to bring a point of view on what should be built, in what order, and why.

Key Responsibilities

•  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned decision-support products, from business problem definition through requirements, build, pilot, production release and value realization.

•  Translate business objectives into technical requirements. Write the user stories, acceptance criteria, data requirements and definitions of done that data scientists and engineers build against, and own the product backlog and its prioritization by business value.

•  Act as the conduit between the business and the technical teams. Run working sessions with Business Management, PGD, Operations and Finance to elicit real needs, constraints and edge cases, then represent those needs with fidelity to the build teams - and push back in both directions when what is being built will not solve the problem.

•  Drive execution and accountability across multiple concurrent workstreams. Maintain the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and risks; run the operating cadence of stand-ups, sprint reviews and steering updates; chase decisions, remove blockers, and escalate early and specifically.

•  Keep stakeholders informed with concise, executive-ready status, decision logs and readouts, tailored to audiences ranging from field operations to senior leadership.

•  Own adoption and change management. Design the decision process and workflow the product plugs into, build the training and playbooks, recruit pilot sites and early users, capture and act on feedback, and drive usage to the point where the legacy process can be retired.

•  Define and track success metrics - adoption, decision quality and cycle time, and realized financial benefit - and maintain a transparent back-cast of forecast versus actual value delivered.

•  Guard analytical integrity. Ensure what gets built preserves the business logic it was designed around, including the objective, constraints, cost treatment and risk adjustment, and that data quality, controls, cybersecurity, compliance and governance requirements are met.

•  Manage external analytics and consulting partners on scope, deliverables, quality and timeline, protecting internal ownership and ensuring knowledge transfer back to NextEra.

•  Coordinate across the Transformation Office portfolio, surfacing overlaps, shared data foundations and sequencing trade-offs so that the individual initiatives add up to one coherent operating model rather than a collection of tools.

Highly Preferred Qualifications

•  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data or Information Science, Finance, Economics, Business or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

•  6+ years of experience in technical or data product management, product ownership, analytics delivery leadership, technical program management, or a comparable role translating business needs into analytics and software builds.

•  Demonstrated ownership of at least one analytics, optimization, forecasting or decision-support product taken from concept through production and into real business adoption, with a specific, quantified outcome you can describe in detail.

•  Technical fluency sufficient to be a true counterpart to data scientists and engineers: comfortable discussing objective functions and constraints, model assumptions and validation, data pipelines and data quality, and the trade-offs among accuracy, speed and usability. SQL or Python literacy and hands-on experience with a modern data platform such as Databricks or Snowflake are a strong plus. You are not expected to build the models.

•  Excellent requirements craft - user stories, acceptance criteria, process and decision mapping - with the discipline to make ambiguity concrete and testable.

•  Proven execution and accountability muscle: running multi-workstream plans, driving owners and dates, managing dependencies and risk, and escalating well. Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

•  Strong business judgment, including enough financial literacy to understand the economics of the decision being supported - revenue at risk, cost, capital and risk-return trade-offs - and to prioritize by value rather than by whoever asked loudest.

•  Exceptional communication and stakeholder influence skills across very different audiences, from field operations through senior executives, including clear and concise executive written and verbal communication.

•  A track record of driving adoption and behavior change, not only delivery: pilots, training, playbooks and retiring the legacy way of working.

•  Experience in an asset-intensive industry - energy, utilities, renewables, aviation, rail, marine, mining, heavy manufacturing or logistics - is a plus.

•  Familiarity with maintenance planning, scheduling or dispatch optimization, asset performance management, or total cost of ownership concepts is a plus.

•  Experience working within or alongside a consulting or analytics partner delivery model is a plus.

•  Experience with financial modeling, scenario analysis or capital allocation frameworks is a plus.

Job Overview

Leaders in this position support the overall P and L management of one or more NextEra generating assets that have achieved commercial operation. This role supports strategic decision-making with respect to such assets, including hedging, operations and maintenance. This role identifies opportunities and analyzes the impact on company financials to maximize P and L profitability.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

•   Manages a team responsible for improving the generating  asset's P and L, operations monitoring, development and assessment of value-added ideas to optimize asset performance and increase profitability
•   Reviews proposed budgets and monthly forecasts, financial analyses, ad hoc reports, and modeling
•   Ensures compliance with power purchase agreements, land leases, financings and regulatory requirements
•   Resolves issues across multiple assets and/or states and presents findings and results to all levels of management
•   Works with teams throughout the company in a manager or coordinator capacity
•   Maintains close working relationships with partners, customers and stakeholders
•   Recommends hedging strategies
•   Negotiates various commercial agreements
•   Leads or assists with value-added projects such as supporting regional leadership in the development of strategic plans, mergers and acquisitions, project development, asset optimization, restructurings and building relationships with off-takers, landowners, and state and local regulators
•   Trains and mentors team members
•   Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

•  Bachelor's Degree
•  Experience:8+ years

Preferred Qualifications

•  Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

•  Supervisor/Management Experience:1+ years

We deliver tailored energy solutions that fuel economic growth, strengthen communities, and help customers achieve their energy goals. Ready to make a lasting impact? Employees in this role are responsible for leading the strategy, development, and execution of third-party sales initiatives for repair services, finished goods, and procured parts supporting wind and solar generation equipment. The Sales Manager is accountable for driving revenue growth and achieving gross profit and margin targets through effective customer engagement, business development, and sales team leadership.

Employees in this role regularly engage with customers, suppliers, industry partners, and key decision-makers through onsite visits, trade shows, conferences, and networking events to promote company capabilities, strengthen strategic partnerships, and identify emerging opportunities. jobs.title: Business Development Mgr
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   96878

Florida Power & Light Company is the largest electric utility in the U.S., providing reliable energy to nearly 12 million Floridians. With one of the nation’s most fuel-efficient, cost-effective power generation fleets and industry-leading reliability, we’re redefining what’s possible in energy. Want to be part of something powerful? Join our outstanding team and help shape the future of energy.

Position Specific Description

As a Business Development Manager, you will support the Florida Power & Light Optional Supplemental Power Services (OSPS) group which is responsible for selling and implementing resiliency and backup power solutions for commercial, industrial, governmental, and critical infrastructure customers. Solutions include backup generators, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), power monitoring, and related electrical infrastructure. In this role, you will build relationships with decision-makers to drive sales with end-use commercial/industrial and governmental customers. This role works closely with the OSPS Project development team to close sales.

An ideal candidate will:

- Develop and execute territory and account growth strategies to identify and capture new business opportunities.

- Build relationships with executive decision-makers, facility leaders, engineers, consultants, and government stakeholders.

- Prospect for and qualify commercial, industrial, governmental, and critical infrastructure opportunities.

- Identify customer resiliency, reliability, and operational challenges and align OSPS solutions to customer needs.

- Work closely with the OSPS Project Development team to evaluate opportunities, develop technical solutions, and prepare preliminary project pricing.

- Lead customer presentations, proposal development, contract negotiations, and sales closing activities.

- Maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities using Salesforce and other approved tools.

- Collaborate with FPL Account Management, External Affairs, Engineering, and other internal partners to develop and advance opportunities.

- Support development of customer-facing sales and marketing materials.

- Represent FPLES at industry, governmental, and community events to promote OSPS services.

An ideal candidate should have:

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Construction Management, Energy Systems, or a related field.

- 5+ years of business development, technical sales, account management, or consultative solution-selling experience.

- Experience selling complex infrastructure, energy, construction, electrical, or utility-related solutions.

- Experience selling distributed generation, backup power, energy infrastructure, electrical systems, microgrids, UPS systems, or related technologies.

- Demonstrated ability to develop executive-level customer relationships and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities.

- Familiarity with governmental procurement processes and public-sector customers is preferred.

- Support the development of customer-facing sales and marketing materials.

- Experience utilizing CRM tools such as Salesforce.

- Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

- Ability to travel throughout Florida.

In this role, success is measured by:

- Development of qualified pipeline opportunities.

- New customer acquisition.

- Revenue and capital sales growth.

- Strength of customer and stakeholder relationships.

- Successful collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions.

This position is based out of the Customer Service East Office in West Palm Beach, Florida. Flexible work arrangements may be available; however, regular travel throughout the state of Florida is expected.

Job Overview

Employees in this role build relationships with national and/or multi account customers to drive sales. This position is responsible for selling FPLES product/service lines (ESCO, Lighting, Power Quality) directly to end use commercial/industrial and governmental customers. Individuals work closely with FPLES direct sales team to jointly close sales on project originated via business development activities

Job Duties & Responsibilities

•   Works across all business lines to establish customer relationships that directly result in sales for FPLES

•   Prospects and relationship building to drive sales

•   Pursues direct sales with customers

•   Develops account and territory planning

•   Prepares reporting analysis

•   Ability to meet attendance and storm duty requirements

•   Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Position Specific Description

NextEra Energy’s MBA Summer Internship Program offers experienced graduate students the opportunity to apply their professional experience and MBA education to meaningful, strategic business challenges. During an approximately 10-week assignment at our Juno Beach, Florida headquarters, MBA interns take ownership of a strategic project aligned with the priorities of their assigned business area.

Opportunities may span areas such as:

- Infrastructure Development

- Business Analytics

- Business Management

- Corporate Development

- Strategy

- Finance

- Data Centers

- Transmission

- Origination

- Other commercial and strategic business functions

Our MBA Summer Intern Position

As an MBA Summer Intern, you’ll apply your professional experience, MBA coursework, and business judgment to evaluate opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and develop actionable recommendations. Near the end of the summer, you’ll present your findings and recommendations to a team of NextEra Energy senior executives. Your experience will also include opportunities to engage with company leaders, participate in professional development and training, and network across the organization.

Key Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree

- Currently enrolled in the first year of a full-time MBA program

- 3+ years of professional work experience

- Demonstrated ability to deliver results, problem-solve, and collaborate with diverse groups

- Strong oral presentation skills and proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel

- Ability to work autonomously while effectively managing matrixed support teams

Employees in this role complete a formal presentation near the end of summer to a team of NextEra Energy senior executives. Other required activities include team building, training, networking, and community outreach engagements. Eligible candidates must be enrolled full time at a university-based school of business, pursuing an MBA and graduating in a forthcoming academic year. Primary role is to perform of financial due diligence and prepare investment valuations of acquisitions and Greenfield projects in the energy industry; including assisting in the planning and coordination of these assignments. jobs.title: Quantitative Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   94157

NextEra Energy Marketing is one of the nation’s leading electricity and natural gas marketers, and a key player in the energy markets in the United States and Canada. As a part of NextEra Energy Resources, we specialize in innovative energy strategies that maximize market value for our customers and stakeholders. Our team is skilled in market analysis, trading, risk management and delivering tailored customer solutions across North America. If you are a strategic thinker eager to make a significant impact in the fast-paced energy industry, join our team today.

Position Specific Description

Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of financial, statistical, and commodity-focused models, templates, programs, and processes for the Valuation team.  Relies on knowledge of algebra, statistics, probability, present value, portfolio theory, risk and return, discounted cash flows, comparable analysis, energy markets, logic, binomial tree modeling, and calculus. Leverages knowledge of coding, information systems, total quality management, and project management to effectively and efficiently deliver a system of valuation.

Deliver sound financial valuation of wholesale power derivatives, including load following, deterministic, and block energy products, mostly bundled with capacity, renewable energy credits, ancillary services, and other products to serve residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers. Executes valuation process for transactions ranging from approximately 1MW to 1000MW with 3 to 36 month terms that yield revenues up to $700MM. Values transactions by evaluating power futures or fundamental commodity estimates to create forecasts based on historical data analysis, multiple regression, number theory, logic, Monte Carlo simulations, scenario analysis, and proprietary models.

Executes regional forecasting assignments for energy, volatility, capacity, renewable energy credits and ancillary services. Researches laws, regulations, tariffs, and market procedures in a variety of markets to create models and forecast applicable costs. May complete ad hoc analysis of forwards, futures, options, interest rates, market conditions, exotic structures, weather products, and other financial or commercial assignments required to achieve group objectives.

Relentlessly pursues perfection, trains new team members, and creates a culture of continuous improvement upon the cornerstone of integrity and compliance.

Job Overview

Employees in this role develop models, price energy derivatives, design and perform quantitative studies and analyses of spot/forward prices and volatilities for making pricing, trading, and risk management decisions. This position assists in the development of core algorithms and models to support trading, origination, and asset optimization decisions.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

- Develops and improves upon mathematical models and translates algorithms into code

- Works with origination, risk management and trading to interpret valuations provided by models and responds to intra-day trading requests to price and evaluate structured transactions

- Assists development of energy price forecast, forward curve, and volatility models

- Designs and constructs risk management tools used in evaluating company's risk profile and exposure levels

- Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree

- Experience: 2+ years

- Master's Degree

jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   97363

Florida Power & Light Company is the largest electric utility in the U.S., providing reliable energy to nearly 12 million Floridians. With one of the nation’s most fuel-efficient, cost-effective power generation fleets and industry-leading reliability, we’re redefining what’s possible in energy. Want to be part of something powerful? Join our outstanding team and help shape the future of energy.

Position Specific Description

NextEra Energy’s talented and diverse finance, accounting and business services organizations provide great value to the organization and its stakeholders.  Due to the continuing growth of our renewable energy generation business, NextEra Energy is recruiting finance and accounting professionals at the beginning of their careers with the aim of developing them into our future leaders.

The Finance & Accounting Rotational Development Program associates will start in August 2027.  This is an associate level role - Early start could be available.

Learn more about the Finance & Accounting Rotational Development Program and our company  HERE.

Rotation associates are full-time and based in the Juno Beach/ Jupiter/ West Palm Beach area.

This 3-year leadership rotational development program consisting of three unique 12-month rotations will expose the Rotation Associate to critical finance and accounting functions in our corporate centers of excellence or business operations of electricity-generating facilities and the growing renewable energy industry.

Degree: Finance, accounting, or business-related degree preferred.

Rotation associates interact with experts in their disciplines while learning  finance & accounting best practices in roles such as:

- Accounting Center of Excellence (COE)

- Financial Planning & Analysis / Trust Fund Investments COE Accounting

- Florida Power & Light Finance

- NextEra Energy Resources Finance

- Tax Accounting & Forecasting

- Treasury

- Nuclear Business Operations

- Power Generation Business Services

- Power Delivery Business Services

- Investor Relations

- Internal Audit

- Credit & Risk Operations

After three years and three rotations, upon successful completion of the program, graduates are placed in a role that best matches their interests and supports the needs of the business.

NextEra Energy’s finance and accounting organizations support business units such as renewable energy development (wind, solar, battery storage), power generation, power marketing & trading, power delivery, customer service, IT, HR and others.

In collaboration with a trained management team, the candidate will:

- Learn and understand the business

- Key operational drivers

- Finance/accounting issues for assigned functional area(s)

- Related market forces

- Understand the finance/accounting impact of business transactions; ensure compliance with GAAP requirements

- Demonstrate initiative, a strong drive to succeed, take ownership of assigned tasks and meet aggressive deadlines related to the finance, accounting, forecasting and reporting processes

- Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure the proper accounting, consolidation and reporting of assigned functional areas

- Support internal and external reporting functions (such as 10-K, 10-Q, management reporting, etc.)

- Comply with all Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) processes

- Execute special projects (e.g., software implementations, Six Sigma projects, Agile projects, process automation, implementation of new accounting standards)

The ideal candidate will possess the following performance attributes and competencies:

- Leadership aptitude – desire and initiative to ultimately progress into a team leadership role; often demonstrated by involvement as a leader in student organizations.

- Team player – collaborative orientation; focused on team success over personal gain

- Driven – self-motivated; committed to excellence and personal growth

- Problem solver – ability to identify issues and develop practical solutions

- Professional skills – excellent communication skills and a bias for action

- Innovation mindset – interest in learning new things and applying knowledge to create innovative solutions

- Process & project management – strong planning and organizational skills

- Integrity – compliance with all legal, regulatory, and company rules and policies

Finance & Accounting Rotational Development Program associates further develop these competencies:

- Technical skills – researching, interpreting and applying finance/accounting rules and policies

- Analytical skills – identifying anomalies and explaining core variance drivers

- Communication and presentation skills

- Financial reporting – preparing financial statements and drafting footnotes

- Internal controls – understanding and complying with the internal controls environment

- Leadership – ability to utilize leadership skills in a collaborative team environment

Take charge of your career!  Come learn and grow with the renewable energy industry leader!

Job Overview

Employees in this job are part of a leadership development program consisting of three unique 12-month rotations that will expose the Associate to critical finance and accounting functions in our corporate centers of excellence or business operations of electricity-generating facilities and the growing renewable energy industry.

- Understand the finance/accounting impact of business transactions; ensure compliance with GAAP requirements

- Demonstrate initiative, a strong drive to succeed, take ownership of assigned tasks, and meets aggressive deadlines related to the finance, accounting, forecasting, and reporting processes

- Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure the proper accounting, consolidation and reporting of assigned functional areas

- Support internal and external reporting functions (such as 10-K, 10-Q, management reporting, etc)

- Comply with all Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) processes

- Execute special projects such as software implementations, Six Sigma projects, Agile projects, process automation, and implementation of new accounting standards

- Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree

- Experience: 1+ years

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's - Accounting / Finance

- Master's - Business Administration

jobs.title: Sr Learning & Development Consultant
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   97896

Florida Power & Light Company is the largest electric utility in the U.S., providing reliable energy to nearly 12 million Floridians. With one of the nation’s most fuel-efficient, cost-effective power generation fleets and industry-leading reliability, we’re redefining what’s possible in energy. Want to be part of something powerful? Join our outstanding team and help shape the future of energy.

Position Specific Description

The Engineering, Construction & Supply Chain Business Unit is seeking a Sr Learning & Development Consultant to join their team in Juno Beach, FL.

This Learning & Development role focuses on designing, developing, and facilitating comprehensive learning programs that support organizational training and compliance objectives across multiple business functions. The successful candidate will partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to assess learning needs, gather technical content, identify knowledge gaps, and recommend effective training solutions aligned with operational and strategic priorities.

Core responsibilities include managing all phases of the instructional systems design process, from needs assessment and content development through implementation and evaluation. The role will lead multiple learning and development projects concurrently, collaborating with cross-functional teams and SMEs to ensure training content is accurate, relevant, and effective. Responsibilities also include developing and facilitating instructor-led, virtual, and e-learning programs; supporting onboarding and role-based training initiatives.

Additionally, this position supports multiple teams across the organization, requiring the ability to build strong working relationships, navigate diverse business requirements, and translate complex technical information into engaging learning experiences. The role applies adult learning principles, project management best practices, and multimedia development tools to create and maintain high-quality training materials and resources that drive knowledge transfer and workforce readiness.

Experience with e-learning platforms such as Vyond, Articulate, Rise 360 and LMS is a plus.

Job Overview

Employees in this role develop and facilitate learning and development programs. Individuals consult with business unit leaders and teams in one or more of the following areas: performance, employee engagement, career development, competency models, talent development, team effectiveness. This role serves as a mentor to entry and intermediate level team members.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

- Partners with key stakeholders to conduct individual or team performance analyses, identify gaps and determine training needs

- Consults with leaders to assess, trend and analyze the learning needs of employees based on current and future strategic plans

- Researches and recommends the best combination of instructional methods, which may include formal course development (instructor led, virtual instructor led, e-learning) to deliver the education

- Identifies, selects, certifies and schedules instructors for training

- Leads multiple projects by assessing, planning, negotiating, organizing, monitoring and evaluating the implementation process through the development and execution of documented project plans

- Manages all phases of instructional systems design including analyzing, designing, developing and evaluating education deliverables

- Facilitates professional development programs to include communication skills, productivity, new hire orientation and corporate culture programs

- Supports program management to include vendor selection, participant selection, evaluation, communication and logistics for training classes

- Participates in development of the annual corporate training plan, budget, and training schedule

- Records, edits and produces video and audio content for delivery via the web

- Serves as mentor and guide to entry and intermediate level team members

- Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

- High School Grad / GED

- Bachelor's or Equivalent Experience

- Experience: 4+ years

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree

- Master's Degree

jobs.title: Sr Associate HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:   95925

Florida Power & Light Company is the largest electric utility in the U.S., providing reliable energy to nearly 12 million Floridians. With one of the nation’s most fuel-efficient, cost-effective power generation fleets and industry-leading reliability, we’re redefining what’s possible in energy. Want to be part of something powerful? Join our outstanding team and help shape the future of energy.

Position Specific Description

Under minimal direction, the Sr. Associate HR Business Partner serves as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to senior leaders within specific business units, aligning people strategies with organizational goals. This role involves deep business acumen and ownership of the unit’s talent agenda—covering workforce planning, succession management, leadership development, and organizational design along with other key HR programmatic processes. This role will act as a thought partner to business unit leaders and lead teams, providing data-driven insights on performance trends, culture, and engagement to guide decision-making. The incumbent will collaborate closely with leaders to identify and develop top talent, manage key transitions, and ensure robust pipelines for critical roles. This person will be expected to handle multiple facets of the HR lifecycle and support multiple levels of the organization including various tactical operational initiatives.

Additionally, the Sr. Associate HR Business Partner will work cross-functionally with centers of excellence such as compensation, talent acquisition, and HR Workforce Advisory (and others) to deliver integrated HR solutions. The role demands influencing at senior levels while maintaining a pulse on employee sentiment and operational realities. Ultimately, a successful partner will show to have ambition, ability to build relationships, support labor relations and able to drive both strategic and tactical people outcomes that enable business performance, leadership effectiveness and organizational health.

This role will be expected to travel through the FPL Nuclear Fleet territory (Homestead, Jupiter and Jensen Beach Florida), maintaining a strong presence across the employees’ work locations and being present in the locations where employees’ work. This role will need to be able to manage a complex workload and pivot quickly to accomplish strong business outcomes.

Job Overview

Employees in this role provide consultation and analysis to designated business unit leaders on strategic HR initiatives including talent and succession planning, cultural assessment, organization design and capabilities, targeted recruiting, diversity and change management. This job partners with HR Business Advisors and HR Shared Services to support initiatives for assigned areas.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

- Develops effective human resource strategies for designated business units in the areas of labor, diversity and inclusion and employee engagement

- Projects and assesses talent requirements based upon the changing markets and business needs

- Develops robust and active succession plans supported by leadership and talent development

- Proactively identifies employee and labor concerns through cultural assessments

- Facilitates change management activities to ensure business needs are not unnecessarily disrupted

- Provides specialized, solution-oriented consultation helping leaders identify, prioritize and build organizational capabilities, behaviors, structures and processes

- Partners with HR Business Advisors and HR Shared Services to develop HR policies and practices, conduct detailed analysis and offer best-in-class solutions

- Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

- High School Grad / GED

- Bachelor's or Equivalent Experience

- Experience: 6+ years

- Bachelor's Degree

- Master's Degree

- Senior Professional in HR Certification
